PART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No: 28 of 1964 , that the servitude described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. In column II, it is described from which land that the said servitude is acquired.

1. Description of the Land : All that allotment of land described as following name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. CO/KSB/2019/797 and dated 19.04.2021 of the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Demaladuwa, in Kesbewa South Grama Niladhari Division No. 572A, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District, Western Province and bounded as follows:

2. Description of the Servitude : Acquisition of servitude right over an allotment of land for the construction of the Access Road to the Kesbewa Ground Water Reservoir under Kaluganga Water Supply Project - Stage II.

01. Lot ‘A’ – Maragahawatta – Extent: 0.0434 Hectare North: Cut drain; East; Cut drain, Maragahawatta claimed by H.R.S Perera and access road; South: Maragahawatta claimed by H.R.S. Perera, access road and road(Road Development Authority); West: road(Road Development Authority), cement drain and cut drain.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/9/2017/WS/304.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, No.1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.19th February , 2024.
